title: The Tale of Two Sisters: Oholah and Oholibah

questions.question: What were the names of the two women, the daughters of one mother, described in the parable?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 23:4 (ESV): "Oholah was the name of the elder and Oholibah the name of her sister."

questions.question: Where did the two sisters play the whore in their youth?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 23:3 (ESV): "They played the whore in Egypt; they played the whore in their youth..."

questions.question: Who does Oholah (the elder sister) represent?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 23:4 (ESV): "Oholah is Samaria, and Oholibah is Jerusalem."

questions.question: Who does Oholibah (the younger sister) represent?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 23:4 (ESV): "Oholah is Samaria, and Oholibah is Jerusalem."

questions.question: When Oholah (Samaria) played the whore, upon whom did she dote?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 23:5 (ESV): "Oholah played the whore while she was mine, and she doted on her lovers the Assyrians,"

questions.question: Because of Oholah's idolatry, into whose hands did God deliver her?
options: The hands of her lovers, the Assyrians, upon whom she doted
questions.correctAnswer: The hands of her lovers, the Assyrians, upon whom she doted
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 23:9 (ESV): "Therefore I delivered her into the hands of her lovers, into the hands of the Assyrians, upon whom she doted."

questions.question: When her sister Oholibah saw this, what did she do?
options: She became more corrupt than her sister in her lust and in her whoring
She repented and turned to God
She burned her idols in the valley of Hinnom
She allied with the Assyrians against Samaria
questions.correctAnswer: She became more corrupt than her sister in her lust and in her whoring
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 23:11 (ESV): "Her sister Oholibah saw this, but she became more corrupt than her sister in her lust and in her whoring, which was worse than that of her sister."

questions.question: Who did Oholibah dote upon first, clothed in purple and riding on horses?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 23:12 (ESV): "She doted upon the Assyrians, governors and commanders, warriors clothed in full armor, horsemen riding on horses..."

questions.question: When Oholibah saw images portraying men painted on a wall in vermilion, who did she dote upon and send messengers to?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 23:14-16 (ESV): "And she carried her whoring further. She saw men portrayed on the wall... Babylonians whose native land was Chaldea. As soon as she saw them she doted upon them and sent messengers to them in Chaldea."

questions.question: After the Babylonians came to her into the bed of love and defiled her, what happened to her affections for them?
options: She turned from them in disgust
She loved them even more and sought their gods
questions.correctAnswer: She turned from them in disgust
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 23:17 (ESV): "And the Babylonians came to her into the bed of love, and they defiled her with their whoring. And after she was defiled by them, she turned from them in disgust."

questions.question: Because she carried her whoring openly, what did God do?
options: "Then I turned in disgust from her, as I had turned in disgust from her sister."
"I sent an angel with a flaming sword to defend her."
"I gave her one last chance to repent publicly."
"I struck her with leprosy like Miriam."
questions.correctAnswer: "Then I turned in disgust from her, as I had turned in disgust from her sister."
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 23:18 (ESV): "When she carried on her whoring so openly and flaunted her nakedness, then I turned in disgust from her, as I had turned in disgust from her sister."

questions.question: Who does God rouse against Oholibah from every side to execute judgments on her?
options: Her lovers, those from whom she turned in disgust (Babylon and all the Chaldeans...)
The armies of Egypt and Assyria
Ten kings of the earth who hate her
questions.correctAnswer: Her lovers, those from whom she turned in disgust (Babylon and all the Chaldeans...)
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 23:22 (ESV): "Behold, I will rouse against you your lovers from whom you turned in disgust, and I will bring them against you from every side:"

questions.question: What cup will Oholibah drink, which her sister Oholah drank before her?
options: The cup of ruin and desolation, the cup of her sister Samaria
The cup of trembling and wrath
A golden cup filled with abominations
questions.correctAnswer: The cup of ruin and desolation, the cup of her sister Samaria
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 23:33 (ESV): "You will be filled with drunkenness and sorrow. A cup of ruin and desolation, the cup of your sister Samaria."

questions.question: What awful thing did they do on the very same day they slaughtered their children to their idols?
options: They came into God's sanctuary to profane it
They had a feast to the Queen of Heaven
They mocked the prophets in the streets
They paid the king of Babylon tribute
questions.correctAnswer: They came into God's sanctuary to profane it
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 23:39 (ESV): "For when they had slaughtered their children in sacrifice to their idols, on the same day they came into my sanctuary to profane it."

questions.question: What will the assembly of righteous men do to Oholah and Oholibah according to the law for adulteresses?
options: They shall stone them with stones and strike them down with their swords
They shall banish them to the wilderness with the scapegoat
They shall drown them in the sea
They shall burn them outside the camp without touching them
questions.correctAnswer: They shall stone them with stones and strike them down with their swords
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 23:47 (ESV): "And the assembly shall stone them with stones and strike them down with their swords. They shall kill their sons and their daughters, and burn their houses with fire."

key_verse_text: "And your lewdness shall be requited upon you, and you shall bear the penalty for your sinful idolatry, and you shall know that I am the Lord God."
